item.title: South Korea Funds LS Cable’s Virginia Subsea Cable Plant
item.summary: The Export-Import Bank of Korea announced that it will provide KRW 300 billion (approximately USD 217.7 million) in funding for the subsea cable manufacturing facility being built by LS Cable & System in Virginia. The state-owned bank stated that this financing aims to assist the South Korean cable manufacturer in establishing a strong presence in […] The post South Korea Funds LS Cable’s Virginia Subsea Cable Plant appeared first on Telecom Review Asia .
